sub_graphs.title: EIP-2786: Ethereum Provider Connection State Machine
sub_graphs.description: Models the connection states and transitions of an Ethereum wallet provider

nodes.label: Provider Disconnected
nodes.description: Provider cannot service RPC requests to any chain at all

nodes.label: Provider Connected
nodes.description: Provider can service RPC requests to at least one chain

nodes.label: Establish Chain Connection
nodes.description: Provider establishes connectivity to a blockchain network

nodes.label: Lose All Chain Connections
nodes.description: Provider loses connectivity to all blockchain networks

nodes.label: Emit Connect Event
nodes.description: Provider emits 'connect' event to all attached EIP-2700 listeners with chainId

nodes.label: Emit Disconnect Event
nodes.description: Provider emits 'disconnect' event to all attached EIP-2700 listeners

nodes.label: Listeners Notified of Connection
nodes.description: All attached listeners have been notified of the connect event

nodes.label: Listeners Notified of Disconnection
nodes.description: All attached listeners have been notified of the disconnect event

external_entities.name: Blockchain Network
external_entities.description: The underlying blockchain network(s) the provider connects to

sub_graphs.title: EIP-2786: Provider Event Communication

nodes.label: Connection Event Triggered
nodes.description: A connect or disconnect event needs to be emitted

nodes.label: Prepare Event Data
nodes.description: Construct event parameter object with chainId (for connect events)

nodes.label: Event Data Ready
nodes.description: Event payload is prepared for dispatch

nodes.label: Get Attached Listeners
nodes.description: Retrieve all EIP-2700 listeners attached to the provider

nodes.label: Listeners Retrieved
nodes.description: List of attached listeners available for notification

nodes.label: Invoke Each Listener
nodes.description: Call each listener with the event data (order not guaranteed)

nodes.label: All Listeners Invoked
nodes.description: All attached listeners have been called with the event

external_entities.name: Provider State Change
external_entities.description: Internal trigger when provider connection state changes

sub_graphs.title: EIP-2786: Provider Trust Model
sub_graphs.description: Models the security trust assumptions between the provider and client

nodes.label: Provider Injected Into Client
nodes.description: Ethereum provider has been injected into the client environment

nodes.label: User Trust Assumed
nodes.description: User implicitly trusts the provider that was able to inject itself

nodes.label: Client Attaches Listener
nodes.description: DApp or client attaches an event listener to the provider

nodes.label: Listener Attached
nodes.description: Client listener is registered with the provider

nodes.label: Provider Invokes Client Listener
nodes.description: Provider calls client's listener callback with event data

nodes.label: Client Receives Event
nodes.description: Client callback executed with provider-supplied data

edges.label: Provider can call any attached listener

external_entities.name: Wallet Browser Extension
external_entities.description: Browser extension that injects the Ethereum provider into web pages

external_entities.name: DApp Client
external_entities.description: Web application that consumes the Ethereum provider API

ambiguities.text: The specification states callers 'may be invoked in any order' but does not specify whether this is arbitrary, random, or implementation-dependent.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume listener invocation order is implementation-dependent and applications should not rely on any specific ordering.

ambiguities.text: No specification of error handling if a listener throws an exception during invocation.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume errors in one listener should not prevent invocation of other listeners; implementations should catch and handle exceptions.

ambiguities.text: The chainId 'SHOULD be equal to the return value of eth_chainId if/when available' introduces ambiguity about when it might not be available.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume chainId may be unavailable during initial connection setup; the value should match eth_chainId once the RPC is fully operational.

implicit_assumptions.description: The user trusts the wallet extension that injected the provider, and this trust extends to all data the provider emits.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Malicious providers could emit false events, misleading DApps about connection state or chain identity.

implicit_assumptions.description: Only one legitimate provider is injected, or the user can distinguish between multiple providers.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Multiple conflicting providers could cause DApps to receive inconsistent or malicious events.

implicit_assumptions.description: DApps correctly handle both connect and disconnect events and do not assume persistent connectivity.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: DApps may fail silently or behave incorrectly when connection state changes unexpectedly.
